ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the input X(s) enters from the left and then splits into two paths, respectively entering the positive input terminals of the upper and lower two summing points. After passing through the summing point, the upper path enters the forward block G1, and after passing through the summing point, the lower path enters the forward block G2. The outputs of G1 and G2 are added with positive signs at the right summing point, obtaining the output Y(s). The output Y(s) is again fed back to the middle feedback block H, and after passing through H, is sent to the negative input terminals of the two left summing points, forming a common negative feedback. Reasoning: Since the two forward channels G1 and G2 receive the same error signal e(s), and their outputs are added in the forward direction, the equivalent forward transfer function is G_eq = G1 + G2. This system is a negative feedback system, and the feedback transfer function is H, therefore the closed-loop transfer function is Y(s)/X(s) = G_eq / (1 + H G_eq). Substituting G_eq = G1 + G2 gives Y(s)/X(s) = (G1 + G2) / (1 + H(G1 + G2)).

raw_record.question_text: Find the transfer function \( \frac{Y(s)}{X(s)} \) of the system shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as two parallel forward paths G1 and G2 driven by the same error signal, with their outputs positively summed to Y(s), and with Y(s) fed back through H to the negative inputs of both left summing junctions. Combine the parallel forward paths into an equivalent forward block G_eq = G1 + G2. Then apply the standard negative-feedback transfer function with feedback H: Y(s)/X(s) = G_eq/(1 + H G_eq) = (G1 + G2)/(1 + H(G1 + G2)).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中输入 X(s) 从左侧进入后分成两路，分别进入上、下两个求和点的正输入端。上路经过求和点后进入前向块 G1，下路经过求和点后进入前向块 G2。G1 和 G2 的输出在右侧求和点以正号相加，得到输出 Y(s)。输出 Y(s) 又被引回中间的反馈块 H，经过 H 后送到左侧两个求和点的负输入端，形成共同的负反馈。推理：由于两个前向通道 G1 和 G2 接收的是同一个误差信号 e(s)，且它们的输出正向相加，所以等效前向传递函数为 G_eq = G1 + G2。该系统是负反馈系统，反馈传递函数为 H，因此闭环传递函数为 Y(s)/X(s) = G_eq / (1 + H G_eq)。代入 G_eq = G1 + G2，得到 Y(s)/X(s) = (G1 + G2) / (1 + H(G1 + G2))。

method.method_draft: First describe the image as showing the output Y(s) fed back through H and subtracted from the input X(s) at both branch summing nodes. Let the common error signal into both G1 and G2 be e(s) = X(s) - H Y(s). The top branch output is G1 e(s), the bottom branch output is G2 e(s), and the output summing junction gives Y(s) = G1 e(s) + G2 e(s). Substitute e(s): Y(s) = (G1 + G2)[X(s) - H Y(s)]. Rearrange to Y(s)[1 + H(G1 + G2)] = (G1 + G2)X(s), giving Y(s)/X(s) = (G1 + G2)/(1 + H(G1 + G2)).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中输入 X(s) 分成上下两路，分别进入两个求和节点的正端；输出 Y(s) 经过反馈块 H 后，反馈到上下两个求和节点的负端。因此两个分支的输入误差信号相同，都是输入减去反馈信号。上支路经过 G_1，下支路经过 G_2；两支路输出在右侧求和节点以正号相加，得到 Y(s)。推理：令公共误差信号 e(s) = X(s) - H Y(s)。上支路输出为 G_1 e(s)，下支路输出为 G_2 e(s)。右侧输出求和节点给出 Y(s) = G_1 e(s) + G_2 e(s) = (G_1 + G_2)e(s)。代入 e(s)，得 Y(s) = (G_1 + G_2)[X(s) - H Y(s)]。展开并整理：Y(s) + H(G_1 + G_2)Y(s) = (G_1 + G_2)X(s)，即 Y(s)[1 + H(G_1 + G_2)] = (G_1 + G_2)X(s)。所以 Y(s)/X(s) = (G_1 + G_2)/(1 + H(G_1 + G_2))。
